title: 국회방청규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 4 (Special Attendance)
(1) Former members of the National Assembly; persons who have held offices in the executive branch at or above the level of a member of the National Assembly; persons who have held offices in the courts at or above the level of a Justice of the Supreme Court; persons who have held offices in the Constitutional Court at or above the level of a Justice; representatives of political parties having negotiating groups in the National Assembly; distinguished foreign guests; and other persons specially deemed necessary may attend proceedings from the special visitor seating. [Amended on March 27, 1995.]
(2) An admission pass shall not be required for special attendance under paragraph (1).
